payload.summary: A table that goes through the policy paragraph by paragraph and says what is being added, deleted or reworded between the 2021 version and the 2026 draft. It is the quickest way to see the substance: new paragraphs on the agent of change principle, on tackling crime against women and other vulnerable people, on conditions restricting high-strength alcohol at off-licences, and on service standards; and the removal of the section on toilet facilities, now dealt with by other legislation. It also records two smaller changes people would notice in practice: control measures updated to allow military ID cards and digital ID where the law permits, and the removal of the requirement for public liability insurance. A good many of the entries are renumbering or tidying rather than a change of policy.
